alerts.title: Slow Horses
facts: They filmed two versions of River's final scene, and one of them was a happy ending that never made it into the season.
Olivia Cooke's Sid is missing from the premiere because she was off shooting House of the Dragon.
The big Coe death sequence plays out in a bathroom, a bowling alley and a motorway service station, locations picked so the characters could be kept apart during the shootout.
alerts.nextSeason: Season 7 is already renewed (six episodes, adapting Mick Herron's Bad Actors) but Apple hasn't announced a date. Speculation: a new season has landed every year since 2022, so most likely sometime in 2027.

alerts.title: Dark Matter
facts: Blake Crouch wasn't sure a second season was worth making until his writers broke episode 5, the nearly dialogue-free "Love and Be Loved," which made him want to do the whole season just for that one episode.
That silent episode reworks the most tragic scene from Crouch's novel and hands it to a variant of Jason left behind after season one.
With the book used up, season 2 is entirely original story, which Crouch called "totally freeing" after first finding it hard.
alerts.nextSeason: Apple hasn't renewed or cancelled it as of late October. Crouch says it was planned as three seasons and he wants to make a third. Speculation: seasons 1 and 2 were about 27 months apart, so a renewal would likely mean a 2028 finale season.
